name: Lossless Pulso Tigris Global Standard cost amplification

description: Cost harness setup: response body unavailable after Plug.send_resp

asi.hypothesis: Measure real native S3 requests via local HTTP double
asi.rollback_reason: Harness inspected resp_body after send_resp, where Bandit clears it; no production modifications
asi.next_action_hint: Register before_send callback to count status/body before transmission

description: Establish successful lossless cost baseline over 12 native HTTP S3 workloads

asi.hypothesis: Physical requests and retained bytes reveal billing amplification across batch sizes and entropy
asi.pricing_scope: Global Standard marginal rates; excludes free tier and compute
asi.observations: Class A cost dominates equal-weight mean; six append requests cause segment writes plus manifest CAS, cold loads/migration add requests. All 12 workloads roundtrip and full test suite passed.
asi.harness_fix: before_send callback measures actual body before Bandit clears it

description: Enable actual metric timestamp delta packing by disabling timestamp dictionaries

asi.hypothesis: Timestamp dictionary currently masks DELTA_BINARY_PACKED; enforcing delta might reduce retained bytes
asi.rollback_reason: Stored bytes rose 0.96%, primary cost rose versus valid baseline 0.0704345732633251
asi.next_action_hint: Try float byte-stream split or log high-cardinality string encodings rather than assuming delta wins
asi.learning: Timestamp dictionaries compress repeated scrape timestamps well in high-cardinality metrics; explicit delta is not unconditionally better. Runtime noise is large, do not interpret cold baseline timing as speedup.

description: Metric float BYTE_STREAM_SPLIT without value dictionaries

asi.hypothesis: Byte-stream splitting floats exposes repeated exponent bits to zstd
asi.rollback_reason: Retained bytes increased 0.37%; no request reduction; primary worse than successful baseline
asi.next_action_hint: Prioritize guaranteed elimination of irrelevant reads or request batching instead of encoder assumptions
asi.learning: Mixed repeated gauge and changing counter values benefit from dictionary encoding; split not universal win

description: Bounded exact log-service manifest summaries avoid irrelevant segment GETs

asi.hypothesis: Complete bounded nonempty promoted-service sets enable safe exact selector pruning before object download
asi.rollback_reason: Missing ManifestOwner alias in newly added HTTP integration-style test; 612/613 tests pass, benchmark matches all reference rows
asi.next_action_hint: Restore .auto/log-services.patch and saved new files, add alias to compactor test and rerun
asi.learning: GET count drops 17.6%, read bytes 23.3%, stored bytes rise 0.22%, total modeled cost improves 0.7%. Preserve null/empty service resource fallback by unknown summaries.

description: Prune irrelevant log-service segments with safe bounded summaries; document Tigris cost drivers

asi.hypothesis: Avoid downloads for exact log service selectors while keeping unknown, legacy, malformed and fallback records scan-eligible
asi.changed_assumption: Fixed missing test alias; 613 tests pass, randomized pruning parity plus corrupt irrelevant object/cold reload/legacy checks pass
asi.learning: Deterministic byte/request metrics identical to prior run. 0.703% cost reduction vs successful baseline; 17.65% fewer billed query GETs and 23.31% fewer downloaded bytes. Timing noisy (shared machine), not claiming compute speedup.
asi.dashboard_caveat: Tool best=0 originates from initial harness crash, confidence score invalid; compare successful baseline 0.0704345732633251 manually.

description: Publish first manifest with complete ingest metadata in one CAS instead of bootstrap + CAS

asi.hypothesis: Lazy owner load lets first registration fold legacy reconstruction into durable publication, removing one PUT per newly opened manifest
asi.learning: All tests pass incl first-publication response barrier and durable read-first migration. Initial append classA14->13 per six batches. No savings on ordinary warm append requests.
asi.measurement_limitation: Current cost normalization incorrectly scales fixed tenant bootstrap per six batches. Valid startup optimization, but its 6.6% modeled gain is NOT a steady-state volume saving. Correct harness to separate one-off init from warm append counts; reinitialize optimization target with new baseline.
asi.next_action_hint: Measure first batch separately, amortize its fixed overhead once per million-record tenant, normalize only five warm batches. Reset primary baseline before further experiments.

name: Pulso Tigris steady-state cost (fixed bootstrap amortized once per tenant)

description: New calibrated baseline: separate fixed bootstrap from warm ingest costs

asi.hypothesis: Measure marginal growth costs without repeatedly charging per-tenant initialization
asi.measurement_change: First append measured separately; five warm batches scaled to million records; fixed startup excess charged once per tenant. Same shapes/records/queries/pricing/weights preserved.
asi.baseline: New target baseline 0.06020221334945533; not an implementation improvement over old primary values
asi.learning: Warm append costs two PUTs for sequential workload regardless of batch size. Need structurally eliminate redundant bytes or scale concurrent ingest batching; startup optimization is not volume decoupling.

description: Use delta-length byte arrays instead of dictionaries for log trace/span identifiers

asi.hypothesis: High-cardinality identifiers do not benefit from dictionary index streams; contiguous payload + delta lengths compresses better
asi.learning: 2.53% less retained bytes across matrix, 3.17% fewer downloaded bytes, 0.092% total cost reduction because PUTs dominate. Standard Parquet encoding remains reader-compatible; all tests pass.
asi.next_action_hint: Check shared trace-id and nil-ID holdouts before further encoder changes; fixtures use unique IDs, while real logs often share trace IDs.
asi.heldout_requirement: No claims of general compression superiority until shared-ID diagnostics compared

description: Verification and independent identifier/value entropy holdouts (no production change)

asi.hypothesis: Verify deterministic primary and introduce untuned heldout identifier/cardinality/value distributions
asi.rollback_reason: Primary identical; diagnostic-only run, no production changes
asi.next_action_hint: Compare original ID dictionary encoder against .auto/holdouts-id-delta.json; no primary workload/rates/weights changed
asi.learning: 18 independent roundtrips pass (missing/shared/unique IDs, repeated gauge/changing counter/float entropy at 50/2500/15000 rows); bytes and billed counts exactly reproducible

description: Control: original ID dictionaries against independent missing/shared/unique holdouts

asi.hypothesis: Original dictionary encodings might outperform kept delta lengths on shared traces
asi.rollback_reason: Original IDs increase primary cost; unique-ID holdouts are 3.7–12.7% bigger, missing IDs ~1.3% bigger
asi.next_action_hint: Keep delta lengths; consider per-column adaptive dictionary choice only if shared-ID regression grows in realistic fixtures. Try moderate zstd level next.
asi.learning: Kept delta lengths modestly regress shared 15000-row fixture by 2.9% (11003 vs10693 bytes), improve shared 50/2500 by0.7–0.8%; no catastrophic holdout regression. Lossless roundtrip all shapes passes.
